_why: Real rows, captured from the goldeneye and local databases on 2026-08-09.
Five versions of the shepherd shipped with every unit test green and every one of them
wrong about production. The tests asserted what a snapshot MEANS; none asserted what the
database actually PUTS IN ONE. `was_leased` was false where I assumed true, `job_status`
said `deadlettered` where I assumed queued, and a job went terminal one minute after a
So this file holds shapes observed in the wild, with the verdict each must produce and a
note on how it was previously got wrong. Add a case whenever the shepherd misjudges
something real. It is the only kind of test that has ever caught a shepherd defect.
